title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member III
description:
Agile Dev Team Members have collective responsibility for the design, development, testing and/or deployment of system functionality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline provides technical feasibility using a range of coding methods and adheres to coding standards to ensure consistent style and format. Ensures systems are high in code and component quality, and are easily modified to support future requirements with support and limited guidance of more senior developers or architects. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline ensures the end product meets the business acceptance criteria and non -functional requirements. Defines and executes tests early, often, and at multiple levels depending on their level of experience. Based on their business products, processes and system knowledge, they provide broad level of thinking for exceptions and other unexpected ways users may interact with systems. Utilizes intermediate testing techniques and tools.

**Exp- 5 to 7 years relevant experience**

**Tech Skill-**

* Guidewire PolicyCenter
* Java, REST API
Insurance Domain Knowledge  

  
  
**Requirements**

Demonstrates understanding to customer needs by interpreting customer needs into viable solutions, providing input into system design. Effectively writes and refines user stories, including clear and accurate acceptance criteria. Performs broad and detailed impact assessments relating people, processes and/or technology, and estimates user stories using relative sizing of story points. Supports implementation activities, troubleshooting user/system environmental issues, and training as required. Effectively supports business in building a Lean Business Case and breaking epics into features. Identifies and raises issues and risks with functional design. Partners with the Product Owner to confirm code and acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality. Executes Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) to build in quality. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a development discipline: Codes instructions for computer programs/objects/components; co nfigures packaged software. Provides input into the solution design and functionality of business applications. Reviews and validates application technical design of team members. Documents and implements programs according to standards and conventions. Analyzes and makes recommendations on the need for system backup, security, restart/recovery, balancing & controls and recommends approaches for meeting such needs. Analyzes and documents the requirements and approaches to data conversion and data modeling. Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. Delivers working code each sprint. Demonstrates ability to read and write simple code. Modifies code in an existing file. Executes basic data creation tools and reads automation test results. Demonstrates understanding of the fundamentals of automation tools and framework. Agile Dev Team Member III with primarily a testing discipline: Analyzes system and business requirements for testability. Identifies complex errors that occur in standard application testing. Develops, documents, executes, and maintains test cases and test data. Reports status of test plan execution through defect logs and defect tracking system. Defines comprehensive test plans needed to achieve appropriate level of coverage. Analyzes test results and assists with trouble-shooting and root cause analysis. Utilizes standard testing tools such as data creation, run batch processes and test automation tools. Provides guidance to others as needed. Applies Risk Based Testing techniques to planning and execution. Writes test cases describing business behavior to facilitate automation. Mentors junior team members in test planning and execution techniques. Contributes to the overall test strategy with limited ability. Assists with resolution of environmental issues. Supports application development, implementation, and user training ac tivities, as required. Participates in key ceremonies to drive execution, improve flow and ensure transparency. May provide limited guidance to junior team members, when needed. Plans work via the preparation for and participation in Program Increment (PI) Planning and Sprint Planning, which includes developing and committing to Team PI Objectives and Sprint goals. Demonstrates working code to Product and Business Owners and supports the Product Owner in the execution of the iteration and PI System Demos. Actively participates in the Sprint Retrospectives and Inspect & Adapt to timely discuss opportunities for improvement and are responsible for carrying out the execution of improvement stories. Participates in Daily Stands-ups to assess progress toward sprint goals and raise impediments. Participates in on-going and scheduled Backlog Refinement sessions. Demonstrates ongoing desire for continuous improvement and building knowledge in area of expertise. Actively seeks out development opportunities to further develop T-shaped skills and become a more cross-functional contributor. Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration and continuous deployment necessary for building the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and implementing DevOps. Offers innovative ideas within area of focus to improve processes. Conducts ongoing assessment of current state and seeks out opportunities for improvement. Conducts research, design, prototyping and other exploration activities which fosters innovation and builds alignment between the customer need and what is delivered. Implements innovative ideas within area of focus. Actively participates in Agile Dev Team Member Community of Practice (CoP) and elicits contributions from group members. Plans and conducts CoP sessions. Effectively manages the communications and action items resulting from the sessions. Performs other functions as assigned.

title: Scrum Master_2940
description:
Job Description
  
The Agile Master has full responsibility for coaching and facilitating the work of cross-functional Agile teams. They create stable and self-organized teams with a clear and engaging direction and help to identify and resolve impediments. They are accountable for successfully assessing their teams’ needs and provide a suitable Agile approach in addition to Agile consultation services to the broader organization upon request.
  
Responsibilities
  
  

* Acts as a servant leader
* Champions change across the organization
* Enables teams to remove organizational, environmental and mindset impediments
* Coaches teams in self-organization, cross-functionality and Agile practices
* Helps teams deliver high-value, high-quality products
* Fosters openness, collaboration and continuous improvement across teams and the organization
* Ensures Agile ceremonies take place
* Facilitates Agile events as needed
* Advises Product Owners on backlog organization and prioritization to maximize value
* Leads and coaches teams through Agile adoption
* Collaborates with fellow Agile Masters
* Provides strategic Agile coaching to teams, Product Owners and leaders
* Mentors Agile Masters and aligns coaching and facilitation practices
* Partners with leaders to resolve systemic impediments, dependencies and risks
* Uses data and insights to improve team maturity, delivery flow and outcomes
* Uses generative AI tools, including Microsoft Copilot and Claude, to improve productivity and work quality
* Validates and refines AI-generated outputs before use or sharing
* Uses AI responsibly within Allianz data-protection, information-security and regulatory requirements
* Builds communities of practice to strengthen knowledge sharing, alignment and continuous improvement

Requirements
  
  

* Min. 3 years of work experience as a Scrum Master with hands-on experience on various frameworks like, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe
* Min. 2 years of work experience in an MNC with a global team.
* Experience in working with leadership and coaches on any transformational activity
* Having an Agile mind-set – Demonstrated ability to cultivate and promote an Agile mindset across multiple teams and departments.
* Critical thinking generated by observation, experience, reflection, reasoning, and communication – Advanced critical thinking skills with the ability to analyze complex situations and develop strategic solutions.
* Living the four Allianz People Attributes: Customer Market Excellence, Collaborative Leadership, Entrepreneurship and Trust – Ability to foster these attributes within teams and across the organization.
* Higher education degree in business administration, change management, economics, IT or comparable education
* Relevant work experience in Agile practices and roles, enterprise transformations, change management, and / or consultancy business – Experience in leading Agile transformations and managing complex projects.
* Experience in different Agile and Lean approaches such as Scrum, Kanban, Extreme Programming practices or similar
* Experience in mentoring, coaching, collaboration, communication, facilitation, conflict management, team building

Competencies
  
  

* Servant leadership and the ability to influence without formal authority
* Advanced coaching, mentoring and facilitation skills across teams and leadership levels
* Strong communication, active listening, stakeholder management and conflict-resolution skills
* Systems thinking and the ability to identify organizational impediments, dependencies and risks
* Change leadership, adaptability and resilience in complex, evolving environments
* Critical thinking and data-informed decision-making to improve team maturity and delivery flow
* Collaboration and community-building across teams, functions and organizational boundaries
* AI fluency, including effective tool selection, validation of outputs and responsible use in line with Allianz requirements

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.
  
  
**At Allianz, we stand for unity:** we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.
  
  
We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.
  
  
Great to have you on board.Let's care for tomorrow.

title: Manager, Product Development
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Product DevelopmentOverview  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Manager, Product Development to drive the development and evolution of next-generation payment capabilities within Mastercard's global network platforms. This role is responsible for defining product strategy, managing product roadmaps, translating business opportunities into scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver impactful payment products.  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise, deep payments domain knowledge, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization. This individual must be comfortable operating in complex, highly technical environments while maintaining a relentless focus on customer value, business outcomes, and execution excellence.  
  
Product Strategy & Roadmap:  

* Define and manage product vision, roadmap, and requirements for strategic payment platform initiatives.
* Identify customer, operational, and market opportunities that can be translated into scalable product capabilities.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to evaluate product investments using quantitative and qualitative data.
* Drive prioritization decisions based on customer impact, business value, risk, and delivery feasibility.
* Develop short-term and long-term product strategies aligned with organizational objectives.

  
Product Development & Execution:  

* Lead end-to-end product development from concept through launch and adoption.
* Create clear business requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and success metrics.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Technical Product Managers throughout the product lifecycle.
* Manage product backlogs and roadmap execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Facilitate trade-off discussions and drive timely decision making across complex cross-functional programs.

  
Stakeholder Management & Leadership:  

* Influence senior leaders, engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to align around product vision and priorities.
* Present product strategy, roadmap progress, business cases, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders.
* Coordinate across global teams, regional partners, and operations organizations to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for payment network products and platform capabilities.

Data-Driven Decision Making:  

* Define and monitor product KPIs, adoption metrics, operational performance indicators, and business outcomes.
* Leverage data analytics to identify opportunities, assess product performance, and drive prioritization decisions.
* Create executive-ready presentations, dashboards, business cases, and strategic recommendations.
* Utilize analytical insights to continuously optimize product performance and customer experience.

  
AI & Innovation:  

* Apply AI-powered tools and techniques to improve product discovery, requirements management, decision-making, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into payment products, operational workflows, or customer-facing solutions.
* Leverage modern AI tools in day-to-day product management activities, including research, analysis, documentation, planning, and stakeholder communications.

  
Required Qualifications  
  
Experience:  

* 6-10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Technical Product Management, or related disciplines.
* Proven experience building and launching customer-facing digital products, payment products, or platform capabilities.
* Demonstrated ownership of product roadmaps and delivery of complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Experience partnering directly with Engineering, Architects, Operations, and Business stakeholders.

  
Domain Expertise (Must Have):  

* Strong experience in Payments, Card Payments, Payment Processing, Issuing, Acquiring, Network Processing, Merchant Payments, Digital Payments, Fintech, or related domains.
* Hands-on experience building or managing payment products, payment platforms, or digital products at scale.
* Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, transaction processing, and modern digital payment technologies.

  
Skills:  

* Strong product strategy and roadmap management capabilities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Excellent analytical thinking and structured problem solving.
* Experience translating business needs into technical requirements.
* Strong verbal, written, and executive communication skills.
* Experience creating executive presentations, product decks, business cases, and data-driven recommendations.
* Proven ability to work effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.

  
AI & Analytics:  
  

* Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day work.
* Experience leveraging AI capabilities for product development, customer experience, operational efficiency, or business decision making.
* Advanced data analysis and storytelling skills using modern visualization and reporting tools.
* Ability to derive insights from large data sets and communicate findings to senior stakeholders.

  
Education  
  
Required  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline.

  
Preferred  
  

* MBA or Master's degree from a recognized institution.
* Product Management, Scrum, Agile, or Payments-related certifications.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Work Placement & Migration Lead

title: Technology Product Management Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Overview:**

Finance Technology catalyst for technology and process transformation, enabling Finance teams to replace manual, non-compliant workflows with scalable, automated, and simplified systems across the bank.

Driving Innovation, efficiency and scalability through automation and Integration, these solutions enable Citi to comply with regulatory mandates and empower our businesses to achieve their goals, both current and long-term.

As part of Finance technology, our products and initiatives adhere to Citi’s strategic architecture principles and support the end-to-end integration of multiple global functions within the bank including Finance, Risk, and Controllers.

**About the Role:**

The Technology Product Management Analyst is a strategic professional who owns defining our overarching product strategy, spearheading business engagement and transformation and contributing to directional strategy for AI, integration and automation capabilities.

Key responsibility will be defining Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.

This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiative and change management.

With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills, tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.

The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.

**Responsibilities:**

* Understand requirements through partnership with business users, cross functional teams, and stakeholders.
* Ownership of the requirement backlog and roadmap, strategy, outlining the vision and direction for the product offering over time, to ensure users derive the most value possible from the product.

* Perform analysis and mapping to trace lineage of data and develop conceptual and logical data models.
* Collaborate with various teams and application owners to unify data concepts across finance applications across Citi.
* Appropriately assess risk and impact when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Understand and anticipate user needs. Analyze gaps in capabilities, opportunities for optimization and efficiency and enhancing user experience, remediating risk, and control gaps.
* Provide evaluative judgment based on analysis of information in complicated and unique situations, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information.
* Report control issues with transparency and take accountability of deliveries.
* Develop plans and execute functional strategies, requiring coordination and integration across units.
* Help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results, and assist in identifying and removing product development blockers.
* Coordinate UAT testing with technology and business users.
* Conduct data analysis to document business requirements at the right level.
  

  

**Must-have skills:**

1.Strong understanding of Finance processes and data flows, record to report, Accounting, reconciliation, regulatory reporting and close process, with ability to interpret financial data. Familiarity with Financial products and asset classes, with an appreciation of how transactions flow from source product systems to financial reporting.

2.Strong working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and their practical applications in business processes across financial services.

3.Ability to critically assess where AI adds value vs, where traditional rule-based automaton / process improvements are more effective ensuring pragmatic and cost-efficient solutions.

4.Data analysis, basic, SQL, Python will be added advantage.

5.Process mapping and problem structuring, breaking down complex workflows into components.

6.Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured AI opportunities, including defining problem statements, required data inputs and expected outcomes.

7.Stakeholder and consulting skills to engage with senior Finance stakeholders , ask right questions and challenge current ways of working to identify root-cause of problems.

8.Experience with Automation and AI-led transformation projects.

**Qualifications:**

1. Techno-functional profile with hands-on experience building tech products that solve real and pressing problems in highly complex and regulated environments.

2. Strong background in financial domain and data modelling, accounting, ledger, asset classes etc. 7+ years of experience as a business analyst in financial services, driving BPM, digitization and Transformation initiatives in a global set up preferred.

* Strong background in Data Management, Data Governance, Transformation initiatives in a global set up preferred.
* Experience in logical data modeling, data warehouse and data fabric implementation.
* Data Oriented, strong analytical/problem-solving skills, related to working with datasets, with an excellent attention to detail.
* A deeply analytical and experimental mindset. Proven ability to use data to inform and validate decision.

* Proven interpersonal skills with ability to partner and influence across organizational lines

title: SD Functional Consultant
description:
**Your Role:**

The Functional Consultant acts as a key advisor to the Business on ERP system processes and solutions. They translate Business needs into detailed requirements and technology-enabled use cases. They develop a deep understanding of the opportunities, risks, and issues facing the Business, and advise on how technology solutions can be used to achieve / resolve them.

  

Main Responsibilities:

* Supports the Product Owner to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed Business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled Business use cases.
* Documents as-is and to-be system processes, identifying areas for overall system process improvement.
* Collaborates with Product Owner, Solution Architect, and Business stakeholders to conduct paper-based design activities, capturing high-level system flows and possible technology solutions.
* Supports technical delivery activities by advising Developers, etc. on expected system behavior, informed by clear Business requirements.
* Configures ERP components and modules to realise detailed functional requirements.
* Performs functional testing on delivered solutions, ensuring it fulfils detailed business requirements.
* Develops Product user guides and training materials, delivering training to end users / support teams to enable Product adoption and maintenance.
* Supports the Product Owner to identify areas where additional security and compliance considerations should be factored in (e.g., sensitive data handling). Works with internal SMAs and Product team to ensure these considerations have been addressed correctly.
* Handles configuration changes and emergency transport for high priority production issues (as needed).
* Provides escalated support for incident resolution related to ERP configuration.
* Provides Business and IS with key functional guidance on relevant ERP specialisms to inform the approach to realising Business needs and architectural evolution.

  

**To succeed you will need:**

* Proven track record in eliciting and managing detailed business requirements.
* Strong business knowledge in a relevant functional domain (i.e. Marketing and Sales, Logistics), and how the opportunities, risks, and issues in these domains can be addressed by technology.
* Strong understanding of ERP technologies, with deep hands-on configuration experience in SD ERP module.
  + Master Data
  + Order Management
  + Pricing/Taxes
  + Output Management
  + Billing
  + Credit Management
  + Interfaces (e.g e-invoicing)
  + Technical knowledge – function modules, user exits etc
* Strong understanding of Integration with MM and FI modules with good understanding of other modules

  

* Experience in analysing business challenges using structured frameworks and methodologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for developing technology-enabled use cases and analysing Business needs.
* Experience in modelling system processes; knowledge of common notational standards is beneficial (e.g., BPMN).
* Able to design and execute functional tests, with experience managing bugs / defects through to remediation.
* Good working knowledge of software engineering, information risk, security standards, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Hands-on experience in Agile methodologies and practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban) is beneficial.
* Good communication skills with an ability to build rapport with a wide range of different Business and IS stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional IS team.

  

**In return, we offer you;**

* Plenty of opportunities to grow and develop.
* A culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behavior and integrity.
* Potential to see your ideas realized and to make an impact.
* New challenges and new things to learn every day.
* Access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group.
* An excellent remuneration package
* Support for maintaining a healthy work-life balance, including vacation, personal, and sick time.

title: Functional Engineer Reporting
description:
**About AkzoNobel**

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

Data and Reporting team is focused on unlocking the value of data as it exists within AkzoNobel systems. We're an eclectic team of data-oriented doers who love to take on new challenges, are always learning, and looking for ways to improve decision-making.

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

Design, develop, test, and implement IT solutions and processes in IT systems like applications, platforms and networks through IT changes, projects in line with global Information Technology (IT) and security guidelines, to support company business requirements to create company value.

The **Functional** **Engineer in Application Delivery** is responsible for detailing design and hardwiring business requirements as per Architectural and Security guidelines. This is done through projects, changes and increasingly more through Agile Devops teams. This requires high quality Stories (change specifications) and projects changes which will allow Engineers and/or Developers to translate into code/configuration. The Functional Engineer sees to properly coordinate, review, approve and execute stories/project changes and has an active role monitoring status, in (unit)testing and change management once developed, including organizing sign-off after testing.

The Functional Engineer has an active role in the preparation and execution of the actual changes together with our partners and external consultants where applicable.

On request, a Functional Engineer can be asked to be involved in solving urgent high priority incidents and plays a role in process improvements alongside with business.

Depending on the domain and the progress of IT Fusion in our organization, the work is either done in agile teams under the leadership of a Scrum Master or in the case of a waterfall under the leadership of the Project Manager. Depending on the seniority of the Engineer, he/she will also assume these project management activities as a role or will take lead in delivery of end-to-end changes.

**Key Activities**
------------------

**Story specification**

Translate business requirements into clear detailed designs. Own and develop high quality Stories (change specifications) and project changes for Engineers and External Consultants to then translate into code or config and a proposal on a change implementation.

**Development & delivery**

Guide, coordinate and oversee the preparation and execution and implementation of the (project) changes and the development of the code/config of Stories. Ensure that all partners follow established standards (process- & documentation standards, coding and testing standards, naming conventions etc.). Review, Approve and control the implementation and/or embedding of new, enhancements and/or modifications of applications, systems and/or solutions.

This results in building sustainable and stable first-time right solutions in a very collaborate team spirit (also with external service providers) and in an engaging way with stakeholders and consumers of the solutions. Solutions are built according to the Architectural and Security principles and changes are timely & adequately prepared & documented and/or code works as intended.

**Testing**

Own testing of changes or stories, and/or actively oversee testing by business. Develop test scripts, examine test outcomes, sign off for unit testing and coordinate business sign off for Application Delivery related testing. Contribute to test planning and test management for a specific release.

Resulting in, changes and/or code are properly and timely tested.

**Incident management**

Perform functional or technical problem analysis in case of incidents or issues as needed depending on the severity of the problem. Perform root cause analysis, document these and share findings. Deploy (or oversee deployment) of updates and fixes. To ensure that issues, incidents and problems are swiftly and effectively resolved.

**Process management and improvement**

Monitor, guard, test and analyze that the use and security of applications and systems regarding the functional and performance aspects are in line with the agreed performance indicators, and if necessary, take measures. Actively contribute to process improvement: e.g. tool development, dashboard/insight development and visualization, script automation. Has a good view of the technical state of the application (technical debt) and regularly discuss and works seamlessly together with the (domain)Architect to develop plans to resolve the technical debt.

Resulting in, available and optimally performing applications and IT infrastructure for the business and, DevOps process, tooling and dashboards are continuously improving.

**Project support**

Support a project manager by taking ownership of specific project deliverables (specifications, config, testing, etc). Define, plan, manage and participate in assigned project deliverables from the own functional or technical domain, in accordance with the IT project manager and involved business project owners. Resulting in, efficient and effective realization of project deliverables.

**Experience**
--------------

**Business partnering**with all the stakeholders in the organization to determine opportunities / requirements for Data analytics solutions that can drive revenue growth, operational efficiencies, customer value etc.

**Project Management:** Should be able to independently manage several projects, track actions and reach out to stakeholders when needed.

**Solution design & development:**

Develop new solution using BI Tools (Power BI)

* Translate business logic to technical calculations that will help the technical team to build the metrics
* Fetch and embed data from SAP HANA, BW, Azure SQL, Excel, flat files, Sharepoint list etc.
* Perform data transformation, engineering, [joint, exclusion, enrichment, pivoting, etc.] using SQL, Databricks Pyspark(Good to have)
* Integrate & prepare multi sourced - complex data efficiently
* Automate tools/ data flow using best practices in collaboration with internal teams and Data Engineers.

**Improve and maintain existing solutions:**

* Suggest technical improvements / automation ideas for existing Analytics solutions
* Test and ensure compatibility of existing solutions upon new software version release
* Improve and safeguard dashboards performance (latency, downtime)
* Educate and train a variety of stakeholders about the dashboard technicalities & features
* Keep detailed technical documentation complete and up to date

**Academic and professional background:**

* Bachelors or master’s degree in analytics, Business, or finance from a premier institute
* Minimum 6+ years work experience in Data analytics & visualization roles in a global or multinational environment

**Skillset and professional experience:**

* Highly skilled in communication and collaboration, with experience in working with cross-functional teams and presenting data insights to executive stakeholders.
* Capable of working independently to identify business problems and opportunities that can be addressed through data analysis.
* Highly skilled in data analysis and modeling, with the ability to work with large datasets and complex data structures.
* Exceptional in creating visualizations in PowerBI (+DAX) that effectively communicate complex data insights to non-technical audience.
* Proficient in using SQL, and other data analysis tools.
* Good to have skills such as PySpark for Databricks, Python or R, with experience in data wrangling, data cleaning, and statistical analysis. Has a deep understanding of data modeling and can work with complex data structures.
* Experience in developing and implementing predictive models to forecast business outcomes and support decision-making.
* Excellent Presentation & PowerPoint skills

title: Senior Project Manager_3418
description:
Role Description Responsibilities
  
  
Are you energised by turning complex, multi-team technology programmes into predictable delivery for one of the world's largest financial services groups?
  
  
If so, this role puts you at the centre of that work. You will own the end-to-end delivery of projects across the Allianz Data Platform and the wider DAP portfolio, from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, and closure, translating complex business requirements into clear technical deliverables that engineering teams can act on.The role sits at the crossroads of business, technology, and data, which means the governance you put in place, from risk and dependency management through to status reporting and escalation, shapes how thousands of colleagues across Allianz Group turn data into decisions.To get there, you will facilitate agile ceremonies and cross-team coordination across geographically distributed teams, and work alongside Senior Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Platform Architects to keep delivery aligned with DAP's three-year architecture and delivery roadmap.What we value most is your ability to bring structure to ambiguity, engage credibly with engineers on technical trade-offs, navigate stakeholders, product owners, and vendors, and coach the project managers coming up behind you.
  
  
**As part of this role you will:**  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale data, analytics, and AI platform projects, from initiation and planning through execution, monitoring, and closure.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear technical deliverables, ensuring alignment between stakeholder expectations and engineering outcomes.
* Work closely with new and emerging technologies to improve platform usability, performance, and scalability across the DAP ecosystem.
* Participate in the full development lifecycle, from design and implementation through testing, documentation, delivery, and ongoing maintenance, acting as the connective tissue between workstreams.
* Evaluate and make informed decisions around the adoption of new or existing technologies, tools, and project management methodologies.
* Define and maintain project governance frameworks, including risk management plans, dependency tracking, status reporting, and escalation paths.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies and cross-team coordination across geographically distributed teams.
* Coach and mentor junior project managers and support the professional development of team members across the organisation.
* Collaborate with Senior Engineers, Principal Engineers, and Platform Architects to contribute to and align with the DAP's three-year architecture and delivery roadmap.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, product owners, and external vendors or partners.
* Drive continuous improvement in project delivery practices, tooling, and team ways of working.

✅ Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor/Master degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
* 5+ years of professional experience in technical project management, with a proven track record of delivering complex, cross-functional technology projects, ideally within financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry.
* 1+ years of experience contributing to system design or architecture discussions (architecture, design patterns, reliability, and scaling) within data, analytics, AI, or platform engineering contexts.
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycles and the ability to engage credibly with engineering teams on technical topics.
* Experience working with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, SQL, Bash) at a level sufficient to understand technical trade-offs and review technical documentation.
* Demonstrated experience in object-oriented or data-oriented programming concepts, enabling effective collaboration with development teams.
* Experience with end-to-end (E2E) Data Product Management, including data governance, quality, and lifecycle management.
* Strong command of agile project management methodologies, including SAFe, Scrum, and/or Kanban.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills in English (additional languages are a plus).

⭐ Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in technical project management, ideally within data engineering, analytics platforms, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise software environments.
* Experience managing the full software or data product development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing pipelines, and operational support.
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe, or equivalent.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern data stack technologies (e.g., Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar).
* Experience working in a multinational or globally distributed organisation, ideally within financial services, insurance, or a regulated industry.

title: Project Manager -Scrum Master - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Job Summary**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-driven professional to perform a hybrid role of **Project Manager, and Scrum Master**. The ideal candidate will bridge business and technology teams, drive project delivery, facilitate Agile practices, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives. This role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, leadership skills, and hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery.

  

  

**Responsibilities:**


**Project Manager Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans and roadmaps.
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including business, technology, operations, and vendors.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, quality standards, and budget.
* Facilitate decision\-making by providing project insights, metrics, and recommendations.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and manage expectations throughout project execution.
* Identify and mitigate project risks and implement corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance, change management, and delivery frameworks.

**Scrum Master Responsibilities**


* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
* Coach Agile teams on Scrum principles, Agile best practices, and continuous improvement.
* Remove impediments and blockers impacting team productivity and sprint commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy and prioritized product backlog.
* Foster collaboration, transparency, accountability, and self\-organization within the team.
* Monitor sprint progress and ensure delivery commitments are achieved.
* Use Agile metrics such as Velocity, Burndown Charts, and Sprint Health indicators to improve team performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote Agile maturity across teams

**Recommended Qualifications:**


* 8\+ years of experience in project manager experience.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively use complex analytical, interpretive and problem\-solving techniques
* Proven interpersonal, diplomatic and influencing skills
* Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication

* PMP (Project Management Professional) – PMI

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

**About FIS**


Are you curious, self\-motivated, and forward\-thinking? At FIS, you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all fun.

 **About the Team**


This is an opportunity to join a talented team of functional and technical professionals working on digital banking solutions at one of the world’s leading providers of financial technology solutions. The team works across geographies and collaborates closely to deliver high\-quality, scalable, and reliable products for the financial services domain.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test, SDET, who is passionate about quality engineering, test automation, and building robust automation solutions for web, API, batch, and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in automation testing, requirement analysis, test strategy, and Agile delivery.


In this role, you will analyse business requirements, participate in grooming and estimation, design and execute test strategies, identify automation opportunities, build and maintain automation scripts, and help improve product quality based on defect trends and testing outcomes.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Analyse business requirements and actively participate in requirement grooming and estimation.
* Work closely with product owners, developers, quality engineers, and cross\-functional teams to understand features and define effective test coverage.
* Develop test strategies, create test plans, and execute test cases for new features, enhancements, and production support scenarios.
* Identify manual test cases that are suitable for automation and develop automation scripts using Playwright, Selenium, and other automation tools.
* Build, maintain, innovate, and continuously improve automation frameworks, test processes, and quality engineering practices.
* Automate testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile channels to improve regression efficiency and product confidence.
* Perform API testing for SOAP and REST services using tools such as SOAP UI and Postman.
* Validate applications through functional, regression, accessibility, mobile, and microservices testing.
* Write, implement, maintain, and review automation scripts and test artifacts.
* Use SQL to construct moderate to complex queries for validating data and troubleshooting issues.
* Participate in Agile development methodologies and sprint ceremonies, including planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Track, analyse, and manage defects while recommending quality improvements based on defect patterns and root causes.
* Collaborate across geographies and teams to support delivery, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

* Strong hands\-on testing experience with a focus on automating web and API tests.
